perfil: Gerie brandishes her chain-shovel "Mercy" with reckless abandon on the battlefield, crushing swathes of foes. She sows terror into her opponent's soul before delivering judgment.

habilidades.b: Swings the chain shovel to deal DMG multiple times.

tpl.s: Slings the chain shovel to deal DMG multiple times. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Terra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Terra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Terra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Terra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ of ATK as Terra Auto Attack DMG.

habilidades.b: Leaps at the target, dealing AoE Terra DMG, and creates an Iron Cage that deals DMG over time. When Gerie is near the Iron Cage, she enters the Lethal status, which increases her Auto Attack DMG. The Main Skill can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Leaps at the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Terra Skill DMG, and creates an Iron Cage. Iron Cage: Links 2 nearby targets, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Terra Skill DMG every second for 8s. When Gerie is near the Iron Cage, she enters the Lethal status, which increases her Auto Attack DMG by ⟦3⟧. Thorned Inferno (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Terra Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Slings the chain shovel and creates Seismic Waves, dealing Terra DMG respectively. The Support Skill can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Slings the chain shovel and creates Seismic Waves, dealing ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Terra Skill DMG respectively. Immediate Execution (Support Skill) can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Terra Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Generates multiple huge chain shovels, each dealing Terra DMG to targets along its path. Her Ultimate can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Generates 3 huge chain shovels, each dealing ⟦0⟧ as Terra Ultimate DMG to targets along its path. Divine: Retribution of Evil (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Terra Mark DMG.

builds.d: An Auto Attack build that increases Movement SPD, attack range, and DMG after casting a skill.
A skill build that increases the number of targets linked by skills and creates chain reactions with Trekkers.

l.b: When Gerie is in Lethal status, increases her Movement SPD and Auto Attack DMG. Lethal status remains active even when Gerie is not at the vicinity of Iron Cage.
l.s: When Gerie is in Lethal status, increases her Movement SPD by ⟦0⟧ and her Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧. Lethal is no longer limited to the vicinity of Iron Cage.

l.b: When Gerie is in Lethal status, increases the range of her Auto Attacks, and she can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When an Auto Attack deals DMG, it also deals Terra Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: When Gerie is in Lethal status, increases the range of her Auto Attacks by ⟦0⟧, and she can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When an Auto Attack deals DMG, it also deals ⟦1⟧ as Terra Auto Attack DMG.

l.b: Increases Gerie's Auto Attack DMG. If Gerie is in Lethal status when the Iron Cage disappears, the status lasts 4s longer.
l.s: Increases Gerie's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧. If Gerie is in Lethal status when the Iron Cage disappears, the status lasts 4s longer.

l.b: When Gerie deals DMG with an Auto Attack, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Gerie deals DMG with an Auto Attack, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: Increases Gerie's Auto Attack DMG. Increases her Auto Attack DMG to targets with ⟨Resilience Break⟩.
l.s: Increases Gerie's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧. Increases her Auto Attack DMG to targets with ⟨Resilience Break⟩ by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: The Iron Cage can link more targets and its Skill DMG is increased.
l.s: The Iron Cage now links ⟦0⟧ targets and its Skill DMG is increased by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Gerie deals Auto Attack DMG to targets linked by the Iron Cage, these targets receive additional DMG.
l.s: When Gerie deals Auto Attack DMG to targets linked by the Iron Cage, deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as Terra Skill DMG to these targets. This effect can only be triggered once per second. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

l.b: Increases the Terra DMG and duration of Iron Cage.
l.s: Increases Iron Cage's Terra DMG by ⟦0⟧ and its duration by 50%.

l.b: Reduces the Movement SPD of targets linked by the Iron Cage. Increases Gerie's Terra DMG to slowed targets.
l.s: Reduces the Movement SPD of targets linked by the Iron Cage by 50%. Increases Gerie's Terra DMG to slowed targets by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG and range of Iron Cage.
l.s: Increases Iron Cage's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ and its range by 100%.

l.b: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases Gerie's ATK.
l.s: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases Gerie's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When a squadmate casts a Support Skill, increases Gerie's Skill DMG.
l.s: When a squadmate casts a Support Skill, increases Gerie's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 2 stacks.

l.b: Gerie can dodge one more time. Increases her ATK after dodging.
l.s: Gerie can dodge one more time. After dodging, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s.

l.b: Increases Gerie's Ultimate DMG.  The Ultimate now conjures up gigantic chained spades to deal DMG.
l.s: Increases Gerie's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.  Divine Retribution of Evil now conjures up 2 additional gigantic chained spades, dealing ⟦1⟧ as Terra Ultimate DMG.

l.b: Increases Gerie's Ultimate DMG. When a friendly unit triggers ⟨Terra Mark⟩ on a target, additionally increases Gerie's Ultimate DMG to the same target.
l.s: Increases Gerie's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. When a friendly unit triggers ⟨Terra Mark⟩ on a target, additionally increases Gerie's Ultimate DMG by ⟦1⟧ to the same target for 15s.

l.b: When Gerie casts the Ultimate, increases her nearby targets' DMG taken. Normal targets will be inflicted with ⟨Fear⟩ for 2s.
l.s: When casting Divine Retribution of Evil (Ultimate), increases Gerie's DMG to nearby targets by ⟦0⟧ for 15s. Also inflicts ⟨Fear⟩ on normal targets for 2s.

builds.d: A burst build that increases the number of chain shovels and allows chain shovel dragging to deal additional DMG.
A build that allows the Trekker to continuously generate shockwaves to deal DMG over time.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of the Support Skill's chained spades. The Support Skill now conjures up more chained spades to deal DMG.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Immediate Execution (Support Skill)'s chained spades by ⟦0⟧. When casting Immediate Execution, conjures up 2 additional chained spades, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Terra Skill DMG.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of the Support Skill's chained spades. When the chained spades are withdrawn, each spade deals DMG.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Immediate Execution (Support Skill)'s chained spades by ⟦0⟧. When the chained spades are withdrawn, each spade deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Terra Skill DMG. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

l.b: When the Support Skill's chained spade hits a target, deals additional DMG.
l.s: When the chain shovel of Immediate Execution (Support Skill) hits a target, it deals ⟦0⟧ as Terra Skill DMG.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, increases Gerie's Skill DMG.
l.s: When casting Immediate Execution (Support Skill), increases Gerie's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 3s.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of the Support Skill's chained spades to targets at less than 70% HP.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Immediate Execution (Support Skill)'s chained spades to targets at less than 70% HP by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, Gerie remains on the battlefield for a period of time and creates seismic waves at her and the chained spades' location every second to deal DMG.
l.s: When casting Immediate Execution (Support Skill), Gerie remains on the battlefield for 6s and creates seismic waves at her and the chained spades' location once per second, each seismic wave dealing ⟦0⟧ as Terra Skill DMG.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG and Attack Range of the Support Skill's seismic waves.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Immediate Execution (Support Skill)'s seismic waves by ⟦0⟧ and their Attack Range by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When the Support Skill's seismic waves stop, deals DMG again.
l.s: When the seismic waves generated by Immediate Execution (Support Skill) end, they deal an additional ⟦0⟧ as AoE Terra Skill DMG.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, increases Skill DMG every second. Resets after the Skill ends.
l.s: When casting Immediate Execution (Support Skill), increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ every second. Resets after the Skill ends.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG and Resilience Break Efficiency of the Support Skill's seismic waves.
l.s: For the seismic waves generated by Immediate Execution (Support Skill), increases their Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ and Resilience Break Efficiency by ⟦1⟧.
